methods.label: Use the two fixed coordinates
methods.explanation:
The lines \(x=2\) and \(y=\tfrac23\) have exactly one common point, \(\left(2,\tfrac23\right)\). Any point common to all four lines must therefore be this point. Substitution into the other equations gives
\[
2(2)+3\left(\frac23\right)-6=4+2-6=0,
\]
\[
4(2)-3\left(\frac23\right)-6=8-2-6=0.
\]
Thus this point lies on all four lines, and there can be no other common point. The answer is one point, choice B.
